set.body:
Three occurrences of `hsmm/v2` in WarOfTheGhostsCodecGoldenSuite.scala (lines 11, 15, 29) name a format the suite no longer tests. Line 55 encodes via `HsmmResultCodec.encode(context.result)`, the CURRENT codec, and the v2 golden was DELETED in the codec merge (`delete mode`), not retained -- I said 'retained' earlier today and that was wrong.

A NAME THAT NO LONGER DISTINGUISHES WHAT IT NAMES, sitting in the one test whose entire job is pinning a serialization format. A reader debugging a golden mismatch searches for v2 and finds a suite that has not tested v2 since the merge.

Docstring and test-name strings only; no behaviour change. Held by codex-storymodel-new-engineer under an orphaned reservation until it lapsed at 14:14Z; I asked them to take it or hand it back and got no reply while their session was expired.
set.title: fixtures: the WOG codec golden suite says hsmm/v2 while testing v3
